title: H2O: Heavy-Hitter Oracle for Efficient Generative Inference of Large Language Models
grouping: Top row: four attention grids, each inside a thick rounded coloured frame (black, red, peach, blue) under its title. A horizontal rule separates a bottom row: a pale-blue rounded panel showing the mechanism (left) and an accuracy-versus-memory line plot split off by a vertical rule (right). The frame colours repeat as the plot's line colours.
shapes_depth: Grids are lower-triangular attention maps of square cells in white, light blue and darker blue, with green-tinted cells in the proposed grid. In the mechanism panel the sentence is a row of word boxes (dashed for future tokens); KV entries are stacked rounded cards (red key on yellow value) with attention weights printed under them and a large red cross over the evicted one; a small matrix with column sums and a dark grey column shows the score accumulation, linked by a grey dashed arrow. The method name is set large in pale blue italics in the panel corner.
proposed_highlight: The proposed policy is the last grid in a blue frame, the only one with green cells, and its blue frame matches its curve in the plot and the tint of the mechanism panel.
lesson: Frame each KV-cache policy's attention grid in the colour of its curve in the accompanying accuracy plot, and give the proposal's frame the same tint as its mechanism panel, so grid, curve and explanation are tied by one colour.
notes: Venue and year from the PDF first page ('37th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2023)'). Annotation note (2026-11-15): teaser combining comparison, mechanism and results; only the bottom-left panel is a method diagram

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

core.what: four identical 10x10 attention-mask grids in a row (dynamic, strided, local, H2O), each in its own frame colour, H2O last

relations.form: identical mask grids with blue kept cells, the H2O grid adding pale green heavy-hitter cells, each frame colour reused for that method's curve in the accuracy vs memory-reduction plot at bottom right

bottom-left H2O panel draws the operation on a token row 'Children laughed and played in the sunny park': a green Query card, red Key cards over yellow Value cards with scores 0.1-0.6, a red X on an evicted key
a dashed grey arrow from the key cards to an attention-score table whose columns are summed (Σ 1.4 1.5 0.5 0.6); the lowest column is filled dark grey and marked with a red X as evicted
bottom-right line plot of accuracy vs memory reduction with one curve per method in its frame colour, H2O's blue curve staying flat

channels.colour: frame/curve colour = method (black dynamic, red strided, orange local, blue H2O); cell blue = kept attention, pale green = heavy hitter; in the mechanism red = key, yellow = value, green = query, so red means 'strided' in the grids and 'key' in the mechanism and green means 'heavy hitter' and 'query'
channels.shape: square grids = masks, stacked cards = KV cache entries, a table = accumulated scores
channels.line: solid black arrows = attention from query to keys, dashed grey arrow = score accumulation, dashed boxes = the KV-cache window
channels.frame: coloured frames = one method; a light blue rounded panel = the H2O mechanism; a horizontal and a vertical rule separate comparison, mechanism and result

quality.strengths: The four mask patterns are identical panels with H2O last, and each frame colour is reused for that method's curve, so the comparison and its result are tied without a legend lookup; the eviction is drawn as data (a red X on a key card and on the lowest-sum column).
quality.weaknesses: The mechanism, which is the contribution, is squeezed into the bottom-left third, smaller than the four comparison grids; red and green each carry two meanings (method vs key, heavy hitter vs query); the score table and the KV row are joined only by a long dashed diagonal arrow.

insights.structure: Top row of four framed attention-mask grids (dynamic, strided, local, H2O sparsity); below a horizontal rule, the H2O mechanism panel at bottom-left and an accuracy-vs-memory-reduction plot at bottom-right.
insights.data: Masks are 10x10 grids with blue kept cells (green for heavy hitters); the mechanism shows a token row, key/value card stacks with attention scores, a red X on an evicted key, and a column-summed score table.
insights.emphasis: Each grid's frame colour matches its curve in the plot, and the H2O frame and mechanism panel share a light blue tint, tying the proposal across all three parts.
insights.flow: Top row read left to right as a comparison; mechanism read from the query up to keys, then a dashed arrow to the accumulated-score table.
insights.avoid: Mixing comparison grids, mechanism and result plot in one figure crowds the mechanism into a small corner panel.

arrangement.units: four colour-framed identical mask grids on top, then a tinted rounded mechanism panel and an unframed plot below, separated by rules
arrangement.inputs_as: a quoted sentence as a token row
arrangement.shared: frame colour = curve colour across grids and plot
